info.comment: I made this project! It now has:54 buttons!Click on the Rabbid to heal it.Press 2 to alter certain buttons.Here's some awesome combos:Mario+Fire=Fire Punch!Ghost+Lightning=YIKES!!!Ghost+Lightning+K-Fee+Exorist=SUPER YIKES!!!Cat+Mario+Kirby+Elmo+Warrior Cats=Teamwork Power!Balloon+Mario+Plant=Mario hates plants.Punch+Crush=Boxing?Shark+Shoop=A Shoopin' Shark.Fire+Flood+Lightning+Tornado=WHY ME?!?!?Epic+Punch=Wipe that grin off your face!Mario+Bowser=Final Boss BattleFun+Fun+Fun+Fun+Fun+Fun=Fun!Mario+Bowser+Fireboy333(hungry)+Shadow+ASDF=SMASH!Kudos to the original creator.
